source.aggregation: maximum published score per catalog hero for this global-priority baseline; not an official per-lane score

protocol.scenarios: 24 fixed-seed constructed states plus one exhausted-pool boundary; not real players, matches or expert labels
protocol.comparison: source-only vs pool-source changes pool constraint only; pool-coach-1 vs pool-coach-3 changes requested depth only; cross-family comparisons do not isolate search depth
notes: No synthetic win rates, match counts or account powers are generated.
No training or hyperparameter tuning. No held-out or professional-performance claim.
Wall-clock limits and hardware can change completed depth; per-decision timing is descriptive.
This suite covers next-pick decisions, not a complete staged ban/pick tournament.
Automatic flex search and assigned member pools are separate in current production code.
